title: SessionConfig
description: The SESSION_CONFIG document (§4.1: 'sandbox env passed as one SESSION_CONFIG JSON document — the provider never assembles env fragments'). This shape is NOT fully enumerated anywhere in the technical plan; it is built here from what §4.1/§3.4/§5.2/§5.3/§6.4 explicitly reference. It is expected to GROW when PR-12 (Modal provider) actually consumes it — treat this as the honest floor, not a final shape. Field nullability convention: 'nullable' means a required key whose value may be JSON null.

sandboxToken.description: §5.2: sandbox tokens are hashed at rest control-plane-side; one per gen. This is the plaintext bearer value handed to the sandbox at spawn time.

bootMode.description: §6.4. Delivered to the sandbox as the NARVI_BOOT_MODE env var.

controlPlaneWsUrl.description: Where sandbox-agent connects back for the sandbox WS (§6.1).

repos.description: §3.4: position 0 = primary; repos are always a list, never a scalar single-repo mirror.

branch.description: Null means create the session branch from the repo's default base branch.

correlationId.description: §5.3 propagation chain: webhook -> CP -> provider -> sandbox-agent -> OpenCode wrapper -> back. Null only when no upstream correlation id exists (e.g. session created without an ingress webhook).
